100% Merino wool is a premier choice for year‑round suiting. Thanks to the natural crimp of its fibers, it traps air to provide excellent insulation, while also wicking moisture quickly away from the body. That means you stay warm in cold weather and comfortably cool when it’s hot. The fiber’s inherent elasticity helps it maintain shape over time, resisting sagging or looseness. With its smooth finish and graceful drape, Merino wool adapts seamlessly to a variety of occasions, climates, and styles. In short, it offers luxury, comfort, and versatility all in one.

The fineness of the worsted wool fiber used in the fabric. The higher the number, such as Super, the finer the wool thread is. The actual number is calculated by the maximum number of hanks of wool that can be spun into one pound of wool.

Professional dry cleaning is fine, but dry cleaning fluid can be harsh on natural fibers.

15542387540288.description:
100% Merino wool is a premier choice for year‑round suiting. Thanks to the natural crimp of its fibers, it traps air to provide excellent insulation, while also wicking moisture quickly away from the body. That means you stay warm in cold weather and comfortably cool when it’s hot. The fiber’s inherent elasticity helps it maintain shape over time, resisting sagging or looseness. With its smooth finish and graceful drape, Merino wool adapts seamlessly to a variety of occasions, climates, and styles. In short, it offers luxury, comfort, and versatility all in one.

The fineness of the worsted wool fiber used in the fabric. The higher the number, such as Super, the finer the wool thread is. The actual number is calculated by the maximum number of hanks of wool that can be spun into one pound of wool.

Care Instructions:

Professional dry cleaning is fine, but dry cleaning fluid can be harsh on natural fibers.

9920283443520.title: Ostrich - Coal Grey Merino Wool Blend Fabric
9920283443520.description:
Ostrich is a premium suiting fabric crafted from a fine Australian Merino wool blend, known for its softness, breathability, and refined appearance. With a Super 50 quality and a wool blend thickness measured in microns, this fabric offers a balanced combination of comfort and structure.

Ideal for mild to warm climates, Ostrich falls under the category of tropical wools, featuring a lightweight construction that enhances airflow and wearability. Wool is often blended with other natural or synthetic fibers to achieve unique textures, finishes, and performance qualities. In this case, the blend can even create a subtle slubby texture, adding character to the fabric.

At any time of year, especially during the warmer months, Ostrich Merino wool composition makes it a versatile and stylish choice for suiting, providing both elegance and functionality.


Care Instruction: 
Professional dry cleaning is fine, but dry cleaning fluid can be harsh on natural fibers
